commands.label: Model Family
commands.description: Which file family this GGUF belongs to (the engine's --family). Detected from the file when the engine's table knows it; the list is what the engine this Template runs on offers.

commands.label: Model Variant
commands.description: Which variant of the family this GGUF is (the engine's --model, e.g. its quantization). Detected from the file when the engine's table knows it; the list follows the family.

commands.label: Image Input
commands.description: Let the model read images. Automatic sends nothing, which is the engine's own default: images are on where the model can read them, the encoder runs on the CPU under 24 GB of VRAM and on the GPU from 24 GB. no is text only (no encoder download); gpu / cpu choose the reader.

optionLabels.gpu: gpu (encoder on the GPU, about 1.4 GB VRAM)
optionLabels.cpu: cpu (encoder on the CPU, in RAM)

commands.emptyLabel: Automatic (enabled if supported, encoder on the CPU)

commands.label: Image Tokens
commands.description: The most image tokens one picture becomes. More reads small text and charts better but encodes slower.

commands.label: Context Size
commands.description: Context window in tokens. Left empty, setup picks the recommended size for this GPU and RAM.

commands.label: KV Cache Precision
commands.description: KV cache precision above 8K context (up to 8K it is fp16). int8 is Strata's name for the 8-bit KV cache that llama.cpp calls q8_0: the same thing, so the web UI may show "q8_0" for it. q4_0 is 4-bit (Hadamard-rotated, half the memory); k8v4 stores K as 8-bit and V as 4-bit. fp16 is 16-bit, twice the memory of int8.

commands.label: KV Streaming
commands.description: From a 64K context, keep the KV cache in RAM and only the attention window in VRAM, so more experts fit on the GPU.

commands.label: RoPE Scaling
commands.description: Context extension used past the trained 262144 tokens. Left empty, setup picks yarn for such a context.

commands.label: RoPE Scale Factor
commands.description: Extension factor. Default: the final context over 262144, at least 1.

commands.label: GPU Backend
commands.description: cuda = NVIDIA, hip = AMD, sycl = Intel Arc (experimental, Linux). Left empty, setup chooses by itself.

commands.label: CUDA Toolkit
commands.description: NVIDIA only. Auto uses CUDA 13, or CUDA 12 for cards CUDA 13 does not support. CUDA 12 also runs on older drivers.

commands.label: GPUs
commands.description: Several GPUs sharing one model, as nvidia-smi numbers them: "0,2" or "all". The first is the main one.

commands.label: Single GPU
commands.description: Use one specific GPU, numbered as nvidia-smi numbers them.

commands.label: Layer Split
commands.description: With several GPUs: where each later GPU's layers start ("18" or "16,32"). Default: placed from each GPU's free VRAM.

commands.label: GPU Roles
commands.description: A role for each GPU: main, helper or off, for example 1=main,0=helper. GPUs not listed are off. Cannot be combined with GPUs or Single GPU.

commands.label: No Remote Expert Optimization
commands.description: With two or more GPUs, leaves out --remote-expert-opt, which setup adds there.

commands.label: Replicas
commands.description: Runs N independent engines, each on an equal share of the chosen GPUs, with requests spread across them. Each holds its own copy of the model in RAM. Stays saved until removed from the model's strata-*.json.

commands.label: Replica Profile
commands.description: One engine per GPU instead of a single layer split, for Qwen3.8 IQ3_S, IQ3_XXS and Q2_0. Replicas and a manual Layer Split override it. It does not set Parallel Requests (8 for two engines, 4 for more). Stays saved until removed from the model's strata-*.json.

commands.label: VRAM Reserve (MiB)
commands.description: VRAM the engine leaves free for other programs. The expert cache takes that much less.

commands.label: Parallel Requests
commands.description: Up to N requests decode together. Each slot takes VRAM from the expert cache. 1 means one at a time.

commands.label: Low-RAM Mode
commands.description: Read the experts from one file instead of copying them all into RAM, for a PC with a big GPU and little RAM. auto decides from the RAM size.

commands.label: Resident Budget (GiB)
commands.description: For the Unsloth variants: the GiB of experts kept in RAM, the rest being read from the file. Default: the RAM less 24 GB, at least 8. Not set when every expert fits in RAM.

commands.label: MTP Draft Layer
commands.description: The model's own draft layer. Off gives about 1 GB of VRAM back to the expert cache, at the cost of generation speed. With Drafter on Auto, Off also disables DFlash2.

commands.label: Drafter
commands.description: The speculative decoding drafter. Auto: Strata chooses best for the model and GPU based on measured speed. Drafters are downloaded at runtime.

commands.label: Draft Vocabulary
commands.description: The draft layer's tokens. cjk is the default, en saves about 110 MiB of VRAM, cyrillic and fr add those scripts.

commands.label: Speed Projection (Experimental)
commands.description: Experimental control vector applied as a projection on layers 4-44. Off by default.

commands.label: Server Host
commands.description: Where the server listens. 127.0.0.1 is this PC only, 0.0.0.0 also other devices on the network (set an API key too).

commands.label: API Key
commands.description: Require this key from clients. Several keys: key1,key2.

commands.label: Image Generation
commands.description: Serves POST /v1/images/generations with Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo. Setup compiles the image engine (needs build tools) and downloads about 10-13 GB of models, under the Qwen Research License. Off removes the image setup.

commands.label: Image Model Quant
commands.description: Precision of the image denoiser: Q4_K_M (4.2 GB) up to 8 GB of GPU memory, Q6_K (6.3 GB) up to 12 GB, Q8_0 (7.6 GB) above. Auto picks by GPU memory.

commands.label: Image Backend
commands.description: CUDA for NVIDIA, HIP for AMD on Linux, Vulkan for AMD APUs, Intel Arc and AMD on Windows, CPU as the fallback. Auto picks one.

commands.label: Image GPU Policy
commands.description: What happens to the text model while an image is made. Auto keeps it loaded if the image job fits beside it, else shrinks its expert cache, else unloads it. Unload saves the conversation and restores it on the next start.

commands.label: Native Image Runner (Experimental)
commands.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Strata's own DiT runner on CUDA or HIP instead of stable-diffusion.cpp.

commands.label: Models Folder
commands.description: Where setup stores downloaded files such as the vision projector and image models. Default: the models folder in the data folder.

commands.label: Download Source
commands.description: Where model files are downloaded from. ModelScope serves the same files for mainland China, checked against its published SHA-256.

commands.label: Calibrate Before Start
commands.description: Tunes the engine for this PC (15 to 30 minutes, longer on a slow GPU), then starts the model. Only applies to a model that is already installed.

commands.label: Build Engine
commands.description: Compile the engine instead of using the ready-made one.

commands.label: Ready-made Engine Location
commands.description: Location of the ready-made engine: a base URL or a local folder.

commands.label: DeepSeek Engine Package
commands.description: DeepSeek: the downloaded engine package (.tar.gz, .zip or an unpacked folder), checked and installed instead of fetched.

commands.label: Update Feed
commands.description: Where the signed update feed for the DeepSeek engine package is: an https URL or a local folder.
